features.text: The patient is 48 years old and female.
The patient's right finger has been painful since skiing over the weekend.
The patient bent her right finger back when going over a mogul during skiing.
The pain in the right finger started on Sunday after skiing.
The pain in the right finger is severe and worsens with movement.
The patient has tried ice and ibuprofen, but they have not provided much relief.
The patient has not noticed any swelling or deformity in the right finger.
The patient can bend the right finger and touch her thumb with it.
The patient has not experienced any numbness, tingling, or weakness in the right finger or hand.
The patient has not noticed any instability or popping sensation in the finger.
The patient has not had difficulty gripping objects since the injury.
The patient has not had any prior imaging or evaluation of the right finger since the injury.
The patient has not had any previous hand or finger imaging for this injury or other conditions.
The patient has not had any previous hand or finger injuries that affected the same finger.
The patient has not had any imaging studies for the right finger since the injury.
The patient has not experienced any locking, clicking, or instability in the finger when moving it.
